newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's parliament passes 1997 state budget.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's parliament passes 1997 state budget.

text.p: The National Assembly approved a 71.4 trillion won state budget for calendar 1997 late on Friday night, parliamentary officials said on Saturday.
The budget was approved in a vote shortly before midnight by 150 to 90, with one abstaining.
A parliamentary official said 241 of the 299 members of the Assembly attended Friday's session.
The budget scale, that includes special accounts, represents a cut of 201.4 billion won from the government's plan scaled at 71.6 trillion won, the official said.
General accounts were scaled at 67.58 trillion won, up 12.4 percent from 60.11 trillion won for this year, he said.
